description: How one to three watches fit a wrist of a given size, checked against WORN's catalogue of 46,000 watches (case, thickness, lug width): how far each watch's lugs stop from the edges of the wrist, whether it wears bigger or smaller than its case, and how it sits under a shirt cuff. Returns the verdicts in words, a link to the watches drawn to scale on the wrist, and the drawing as a card where cards are shown. Names are matched as people say them; case_mm and lug_to_lug_mm, when known, make the answer exact.

case_mm.description: Case diameter in mm (width, for a square case), if you know it; it picks the right size where the model comes in several. Leave out and WORN uses its catalogue

lug_to_lug_mm.description: Lug-to-lug span in mm from the maker's specs, if you know it. WORN's catalogue does not hold it: left out, it is estimated at 1.2 times the case and said to be

name.description: The watch's brand and model as the person would say them, e.g. 'Tudor Black Bay 58' or 'Omega Seamaster Diver 300M'. WORN looks it up in its catalogue of 46,000 watches

note.description: One short line on why you suggest this watch, shown under it

thickness_mm.description: Case thickness in mm, if you know it; WORN's catalogue fills it where it can

wrist_mm.description: Wrist circumference in mm, measured where a watch sits (17 cm is 170)

name: fit_watch
title: Fit watches to a wrist
